text:
About **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** experienced tree-cover loss in 2022, roughly 2.8% of the 17.6-hectare property.

The total mapped loss event was 0.6 hectares; the remaining 0.1 hectares was outside the national forest map. Another 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in smaller patches, but the evidence does not specify how much of that was native forest.

Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish permanent deforestation or its cause.
